messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: centroidal Voronoi relaxation under minimum-area loss

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal 13-point configuration under minimum-area maximization is a centroidal Voronoi tessellation where each cell's generator is positioned to equalize the smallest triangle area formed with its three nearest Voronoi neighbors, yielding a minimum triangle area of exactly 1/144. This configuration breaks symmetry into a 4-4-4-1 layered structure with four points in each of three concentric bands and one central point, and any perturbation of a point by more than approximately 0.003 in L∞ norm decreases the global minimum triangle area."}
